name: vercel-ai-sdk
description: TypeScript toolkit for building AI-powered applications with streamText, generateObject, and multi-provider model routing.
author: Awesome API Skills Team
pitfalls: Using deprecated OpenAIStream and StreamingTextResponse from AI SDK v2/v3 instead of streamText() and result.toDataStreamResponse() in v4+
Passing raw JSON strings instead of Zod schemas to generateObject() or tool parameters
Calling provider SDKs directly in client components instead of server route handlers
checklist: Using ai v4+ core primitives (generateText, streamText, generateObject, streamObject)
Streaming endpoints return result.toDataStreamResponse() for useChat compatibility
